ev.q: During 2003–2012, the EOC had 55 activations and 109 utilizations.
The most common type of activation was for infectious disease outbreaks (22, 40.0%)
The most common utilization events were for foodborne disease outbreaks (25).
Forty-one (74.6%) of the 55 activations were for responses occurring within the United States
natural disaster activations occurred most commonly in August
CDC analyzed data from daily reports and activity logs.

methods_quotes.q: To enumerate activities conducted by the EMP during 2003–2012, CDC analyzed data from daily reports and activity logs.
